globals.name: input-file
globals.description: Path to file containing JSON document input

operations.name: query
operations.description: Run SQL and return columns and rows as JSON (open mode: runs any statement the database accepts; identical to exec)

params.name: statement
params.description: Exactly one SQL statement (any SQL; multiple statements run in order and the last one's rows are returned)

params.name: db
params.description: Path of a SQLite database file. PostgreSQL DSNs are not accepted here (argv is visible to other users); use connection

params.name: connection
params.description: Name of a configured connection: the environment variable LMSQL_<NAME> holds a SQLite path or a postgres:// DSN

params.name: maxRows
params.description: Return at most this many rows (1..10000); more set truncated: true

params.name: maxBytes
params.description: Cap on the serialized rows in bytes (1..16777216); hitting it sets truncated: true

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Abort the statement after this many milliseconds (1..300000), also the lock wait

operations.name: exec
operations.description: Run SQL and return rows plus rows_affected and last_insert_rowid (open mode: identical to query; both run any statement)

params.name: statement
params.description: Exactly one SQL statement (any SQL: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, ...; RETURNING and SELECT rows are returned)

params.name: db

params.name: connection

params.description: Return at most this many rows (1..10000); more set truncated: true

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Abort the statement after this many milliseconds (1..300000), also the lock wait
